fixes.what: Flat layout: makeRoot no longer copies tcb/scripts into each root (it did not exist, and a copy per test case breaks the no-bursts rule); the script runs as tcb-build/tcb/watch.mjs, found relative to the test file. The intake tests (T18, T19, T21, X6) use ONE shared stub folder per file run (tmp/wk-stubs-*: a copy of watch.mjs and lib.mjs plus the seven step stubs), removed in an after() hook; installStubs now marks the root to run that copy and writes only the root's stub-config.json.
Flat layout: lib imported from tcb/lib.mjs (was tcb/scripts/lib.mjs); the script runs as tcb-build/tcb/status.mjs; no scripts copy per root.

Flat layout: lib imported from tcb/lib.mjs; the script runs as tcb-build/tcb/handover.mjs (T3's root-without-tcb case still passes, since the script never came from the root); no scripts copy per root.

The intake spawn and the intake's step scripts were found through <root>/tcb/scripts/...; both now come from the script's own folder (import.meta.url), as the flat-layout rule requires. In the contract layout this is the same path.

raise's one-line brief named <root>/tcb/scripts/status.mjs literally; it now names the sibling status.mjs beside handover.mjs (forward slashes), which equals the spec's text in the contract layout and is a real path in the flat one.

Liveness from the process list compared start_time strings exactly. lib (lib-harden) now writes a process's own start time from its own clock and defines sameStartTime/START_TOLERANCE_MS for every comparison (CONTRACT 4.4, 4.9), so a real watcher's or alarm's record would never match its PowerShell CreationDate exactly. aliveIn (both scripts) and endturn's watcher.lock-vs-watcher.json check now use lib.sameStartTime. No test failed on this (the tests' sleeper records use the PowerShell time), it was a latent defect against the current library.

notes: No test was weakened; no assertion was changed. All edits to the tests are path/layout only.
Most of build-U1b's lib_change_requests were met by the finished library (the scripts ran green against it unchanged apart from the fixes above); none is needed for these three scripts now.
